d:
Olympique de Marseille delivered a sensational away performance, storming to a commanding 5-2 win over Angers SCO!
Angers SCO opened the scoring early in the 14th minute through Lilian Raolisoa, but Marseille responded emphatically. First-half strikes from Himad Abdelli and Nouhoum Kamissoko turned the game around before Amine Gouiri made it 3-1. Amine El Ouazzani pulled one back from the penalty spot to spark hopes of an Angers comeback, but late goals from Amine Harit and Igor Paixão sealed an emphatic 5-goal display for Olympique de Marseille!
